ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the surface is approximately 97% low-intensity black pigmentation with 3% high-intensity pixels localized at the tips and notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-intensity pixels across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white and beige geometric clusters at the distal tips; a small, irregular high-intensity white patch is visible at the immediate base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees and significant vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude irregular peaks at the distal tips due to biological accumulation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from notch to mid-lobe, transitioning to a straight diagonal trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular, high-contrast white and brown pixel clusters (barnacles) localized heavily on the right distal tip and moderately on the left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological colonization (barnacles) on both fluke tips; minor white scarring or depigmentation visible at the leading edge of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a unique, irregular protruding silhouette caused by dense barnacle colonization, altering the geometric profile compared to the left tip.
